narrative_summary: Making the order sync process resilient to bad data and adding email notifications for errors.

kips.text: SyncOrderFeedback was changed to log errors instead of crashing the process
SyncStocks error handling was similarly hardened to log rather than fail
CSV parsing in CsvAuftragsRueckmeldung and CsvBestandsmeldung was hardened to skip records with bad or missing data
Email notifications were adopted as the error reporting mechanism for sync operations
An EmailNotificationService was created with SmtpConfiguration support
Email error reporting was integrated into all four sync commands (Orders, OrderFeedback, Products, Stocks)
SMTP credentials were added to Kubernetes secrets for both staging and production environments
SMTP was configured to use STARTTLS for secure email delivery
Global try-catch error boundaries were added to all sync commands to ensure unhandled errors are captured and reported via email
